rules.summary: Review this common-noun sequence; keep established technical terms.
rules.description: Counts NN modifiers followed by an NN/NNS head within a shallow NP chunk, stopping at terms, identifiers, and configured verb forms in predicate position.
rules.limitations: Alpha defaults are editorial policy proposals; corpus precision has not been established. This surface measurement does not establish a grammatical error, a need for revision, or authorship. A shallow NP is not a dependency tree, and a noun sequence can be an appropriate domain term. Interior NNS tags cause abstention: they can be plural modifiers or misclassified finite verbs. The negative modal "cannot" breaks a noun run even when tagged NN; other tagging ambiguity remains possible. Configured verb forms are literal words; a form that is also a noun modifier shortens a genuine stack.
rules.opt_in_reason: Frozen hypothesis H1 of the pattern protocol. Its development estimate of +2.96 points fell to +0.41 on the confirmation partition at p 0.727, so the association did not carry to unseen text.

rules.summary: Check whether repeated paired contrasts carry distinct information.

rules.limitations: Alpha defaults are editorial policy proposals; corpus precision has not been established. Only the declared structures are recognized; no semantic equivalence is inferred. A single contrast is ordinary English and the window allows two; the rule measures repetition of the shape, not its use.
rules.opt_in_reason: A house tic rather than a signal: none in the controlled arm and 0.007 per thousand words in human prose, against 0.161 in one documentation tree. The per-project path is "corpus propose", which learns a tree's own over-used constructions.

rules.opt_in_reason: Fires more on human prose, 0.499 per thousand words against 0.300 in the controlled arm.
